scope: FlashDB KVDB core: upstream FlashDB 2.1.1 (third-party/upstream/flashdb/src/fdb.c, fdb_kvdb.c, fdb_utils.c; profile g2-apollo-main-81, g2 fdb_cfg.h) vs stock 0x543c48..0x545528 + 0x585800..0x585ce0
method: Renode 1.17 M55 stub-patch harness; FAL find/read/write/erase/device-find/fal_init (0x597cde/0x597d34/0x597d72/0x597db0/0x597e54/0x597dec) and printf 0x4733ee stubbed onto a RAM NOR model (NOR AND-write, 4 KiB erase) of the kvdb partition seeded from build/em9305-nor-20261122/nor-stock-formatted.bin @0x1FC0000 (0x38000, 56 used sectors). Each test: random control (lock/unlock/sec size/not-format), init, 1..70 random get/set/delete/set_default ops, injected read/write/erase failures; records every stub call with args, written-data hash, all returns/out blobs, final 56 sector hashes and the 0x8ac db object (struct padding bytes and code pointers masked).

runs.note: harness artifact: 1-char printf(" ") strings not normalised (hrt_norm required len>=2); fixed (len>=1)
harness artifact: struct padding byte (cur_kv+3, cur_sector+3, sector_cache[i]+3) copied from uninitialised stack; masked

runs.survivors: GC threshold (scenario gap) and _fdb_write_status sync flag (equivalent in FAL mode, retired)

runs.note: added flash mode with exactly 2-3 empty sectors + long op sequences (GC path); 3 long GC tests differ by one recorded word beyond the 2048-word capture; windowed probe running
runs.probe: windowed probe (ids 0x68/0x69/0x86): divergence is the value read in get_kv after a KV-cache hit whose read_kv failed CRC: stock fal_partition_read(addr=0x544fed) vs C (addr=0xf). Shared upstream FlashDB 2.1.1 UB (find_kv cache path returns true after failed read_kv; kv.addr.value/value_len uninitialised) present in stock too; not a C reconstruction error.

harness_stub_args: hrt_stub_dispatch records the callee address and every argument (arity table; printf arity from the format) normalised (strings by content, stack pointers to a constant) and both sides are compared word-for-word; transparent libc calls are not recorded.

equivalent_mutants_retired.reason: sync flag is only consumed by _fdb_file_write (file mode); FAL mode ignores it -> semantically equivalent, survived 40/40

known_stock_shared_bug.what: FlashDB 2.1.1 find_kv(): with FDB_KV_USING_CACHE a cache hit returns true even if read_kv() then fails (CRC32 mismatch / bad length header); get_kv() then reads kv.addr.value for kv.value_len (both uninitialised) and fdb_kv_get_blob reports a garbage length / blob.saved fields.
known_stock_shared_bug.stock: present in stock 2.2.6.10 (stock 0x54454a path read flash address 0x544fed = stack garbage in probe test 0x68)
known_stock_shared_bug.decision: kept as-is in C for fidelity to stock (parent instruction 17:10 CST); documented in g2/src/apollo-main/storage/flashdb/flashdb/blob_read.c
known_stock_shared_bug.trigger: only after flash corruption of a KV that is in the KV cache
known_stock_shared_bug.harness_handling: for a get op in which FlashDB itself reported a CRC/length error, the value-read address/size, value bytes and returned len/saved fields (uninitialised-derived on both sides) are masked; all other recorded words unchanged
